summary: Product leader with a payments and banking background at Starling Bank and Revolut, focused on shipping measurable improvements to payment reliability and dispute rates: a 34% cut in Faster Payments settlement failures and an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes across a product reaching 2.1 million customers.

bullets: Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
Built payments features and led hiring for the team
Reduced chargeback disputes by 18% by redesigning the claims flow
Launched card controls used by 2.1 million customers
